recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中，脂肪空泡之間的造血細胞裡有大量細胞質含鮮紅色粗顆粒的嗜酸性球及其前驅細胞（部分核仍呈圓形），中央可見一顆巨核細胞；嗜酸性球系明顯增加但無芽細胞聚集，是 HES 骨髓的表現。
features: Numerous eosinophilic myelocytes, metamyelocytes and mature eosinophils with coarse bright red cytoplasmic granules
Eosinophil precursors with round to indented nuclei alongside segmented forms, indicating full maturation
Single megakaryocyte in the center with normal-appearing lobulated nucleus
Background neutrophilic and erythroid precursors with scattered small lymphocytes; no sheets of blasts
Interspersed adipocytes and extravasated red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows marked eosinophilic hyperplasia, with abundant eosinophilic myelocytes, metamyelocytes and mature eosinophils containing coarse bright red granules. Maturation appears orderly, and neutrophilic and erythroid precursors and a morphologically unremarkable megakaryocyte are present. No increase in blasts, atypical mast cell aggregates, or discrete lymphoid infiltrates is evident in this field. The findings represent nonspecific eosinophilic hyperplasia; with the aberrant T-cell population identified by flow cytometry, they are consistent with the lymphocytic variant of hypereosinophilic syndrome.

ddx.vs: Marrow eosinophilic hyperplasia looks similar, but PDGFRA cases often have scattered spindled CD25+ mast cells and fibrosis and require FIP1L1-PDGFRA testing to exclude.
Would show compact aggregates of spindled mast cells highlighted by tryptase/CD117, which are not seen in this field.
Shows increased blasts with abnormal eosinophils bearing large basophilic-appearing granules, whereas no blast increase is evident here.
